name: Telegram intake (polling)
description: Every 2 min getUpdates → commands/questions → Telegram query (Claude + BigQuery); post text or screenshot → FB post to listing (Claude) → BigQuery + reply; ❌ deletes. Telegram 5xx/429/network skipped, other errors alert.

parameters.text:
🏠 Stan Hunter bot

📸 Screenshot FB objave — Claude pročita sliku i doda oglas u bazu (pre screenshota otvori „more“)
/oglas + tekst — dodaj FB oglas u bazu
/top + pitanje — najbolji oglasi iz baze (npr. /top dvosobni na Vračaru do 450)
/top bez pitanja — 5 najboljih ponuda

Možeš i bez komande: kratko pitanje ide u bazu, a tekst oglasa u FB tok.

nodeGroups.name: Delete button

nodeGroups.name: Screenshot (Claude vision)
nodeGroups.description: Photo from my chat → getFile → download largest size → FB post to listing (Claude reads the screenshot)

versionMetadata.name: FB: known flat reply, score after load
versionMetadata.description: FB listing confirmed as an existing flat (Claude vision) → short reply with the existing listing's score and link, not loaded again. New FB listing → load → wait for load job → score from listings_scored → reply with score, photo quality and load status.
